name: akbun-analysis
description: Code review and change analysis skills — why/how investigation of PRs from git history, diff blast-radius proof by execution, credential authn/authz checks, and adversarial review

interface.shortDescription: Investigate why and how code changed, prove what a diff breaks, check credentials, and review adversarially
interface.longDescription: Investigates a PR or subsystem in two steps: why it was built that way, from git history, gh PRs, issues, reviews and repository docs with quotes and confidence levels, then how it works under those constraints. Finds what a diff breaks outside the diff and proves the one fact that makes it safe by running code. Checks who issues, reads and scopes tokens, API keys, certificates and service accounts, and reviews code or claims adversarially with counterexamples.
defaultPrompt: 이 토큰은 누가 발급했고 누가 읽으며 어디까지 허용하는지 보안 관점에서 확인해줘
내가 구현한 코드와 주장을 적대적으로 리뷰해서 숨은 가정과 깨지는 반례를 들어줘
이 PR이 왜 나왔고 바뀐 부분이 어떻게 동작하는지 gh와 git만으로 조사해줘 (akbun-analysis-git-whyandhow)
이 PR을 머지하면 diff 밖 어디가 깨지는지 실행으로 증명하고 PR에 코멘트 달아줘 (akbun-analysis-gitdiff-blast-radius)
